scope: Outcome-blind completion of the two remaining Wave 1 tasks for the jointly frozen 30-task proportional checkpoint

checkpoint_design.selection_rule: Complete every still-missing Wave 1 task and the four not-yet-run tasks in frozen Wave 2 sentinel tranche 2.
checkpoint_design.revision_reason: The first task established an observed Daytona ceiling of three simultaneous sandboxes; the valid gRPC outcomes are preserved and only unstarted tasks remain.

effective_limits.wall_timeout_clock: absolute Unix wall time; includes laptop sleep

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: one four-route task at a time, at most three concurrent Harbor trials, followed by a zero-sandbox cleanup check

interpretation_guard: Complete both tasks before using their outcomes to choose any follow-on task. Infrastructure failures remain excluded and are recovered route-for-route.
